title: Child process or wait with no limit of its own
check: Each child call has its own timeout or is covered by .github/test-limits.js; the step passes in enforce mode.

title: Elapsed time read from the wall clock
check: Durations use sinceT0() or performance.now(); the hook clock test passes with the clock 20 s back and 20 s forward.

title: Tests that freeze the clock
check: The stub freezes at Math.floor(performance.timeOrigin); context-watch.test.js runs too, since --quick skips it.
origin: Lesson: a clock change passed three review rounds and broke two tests that stub the clock

title: Assertions that depend on the launcher path length
check: Passes at launcher lengths 75, 157, 158, 164, 200, 281 on Windows and in the Linux sweep.

title: A time budget a test must fit under
check: The test alone passes with one busy loop per core; any failure sign is checked against Load-sensitive tests in dev/release-state.md.

title: Workflow job and step limits
check: node dev/check-workflow-timeouts.js passes; each limit is at least twice the slowest passing time.

title: Shared code in one copy only
check: The same change is in both copies, and the cmp list in tests.yml passes.

title: Shipped file changed
check: SHA256SUMS regenerated with --sums and the version raised in plugin.json with a CHANGELOG line.

title: Release zip build
check: Two builds of the zip from HEAD are byte for byte the same at UTC-5 and UTC.

title: Hook or skill behavior
check: A host run in a scratch repo shows the change, or the PR says untested in a host and auto-merge stays off.
